description: Raise lifecycles for an ASX company: every capital raise it announced, with announced vs completed amounts and both filings, and percent taken. With a symbol, the full raise ledger for one company; without a symbol, a market-wide scan for institutional placements that closed short. Not suited to retail entitlement offers or SPPs, whose shortfalls are routine rather than findings. Free.

limit.description: Max rows (default 25, max 200; responses are capped at 30,000 characters).

minPctTaken.description: Scan only: flag placements that closed below this percent of announced (default 80).

sinceDays.description: Scan only: how far back to look (default 730).

symbol.description: Optional ticker — omit to scan the whole market for failed placements.

name: capital_thread
title: Capital thread
